literal: I am glad that we have become acquainted -- the impersonal des bilonnyal (it has pleased me) with what pleased: tewawwekʼin, we got acquainted; no second person, so it addresses nobody's gender
provenance: am-agent-v1;fix=FSI Amharic Basic Course 1964 vol. 1 p. 297 vocabulary (tewawweKe - mettewaweK - yittawawwaKal: to know each other, to be acquainted, to be introduced) and Note 30.1 p. 336 (the verb /dess malet/ to please is an impersonal verb: dess bilon nebber);in-pack-frame=hitchhiking.thank-you-for-the-ride (ስላሳፈሩኝ አመሰግናለሁ: sile- with the perfect);derived=sile- + 1pl perfect of ተዋወቀ + ደስ ብሎኛል;rule=ደስ ብሎኛል alone is kind-words.i-like-it-very-much without its በጣም and does not name the meeting;row-corrections-v8;ipa=bgn-am
